questions.q: A company has 40 employees. In 2022, the average bonus of the first 30 was Rs. 40000, of the last 30 was Rs. 60000, and of the first 10 and last 10 together was Rs. 50000. Next year, the average bonus of the first 10 increased by 100%, of the last 10 increased by 200% and of the remaining employees was unchanged. Then, the average bonus, in rupees, of all 40 employees in 2023 was

questions.q: A vessel contained a certain amount of a solution of acid and water. When 2 litres of water was added, the new solution had 50% acid. When 15 litres of acid was further added, the final solution had 80% acid. The ratio of water and acid in the original solution was
questions.explain: Let the initial amount of acid be A and water be W. After adding 2L water, we have A acid and W+2 water. Total is A+W+2. Acid concentration is $A/(A+W+2) = 0.5 \implies A=W+2$. Next, 15L acid is added. Total acid is A+15, total solution is A+W+2+15=A+W+17. Acid concentration is $(A+15)/(A+W+17)=0.8$. Substitute $W=A-2$: $(A+15)/(A+(A-2)+17)=0.8 \implies (A+15)/(2A+15)=0.8 \implies A+15=1.6A+12 \implies 0.6A=3 \implies A=5$. Then $W=A-2=3$. The original ratio of water to acid was W:A = 3:5.
